content: Anti-VEGF therapy is now considered a standard treatment option for managing proliferative diabetic retinopathy (PDR) as well as diabetic macular edema. This approach has been shown to result in improved long-term visual outcomes for patients. However, despite its effectiveness, the treatment often necessitates the administration of multiple intravitreal injections over time. Additionally, in certain cases, adjunctive laser therapy may still be required to achieve optimal disease control.
